Looking at panel **H (TBI – HYP)**, the fold increase in acetylated tau (Ac‑tau/tau) across all post‑injury time points (6 h, 12 h, 24 h, 48 h, 2 weeks) remains at or below the sham‑injury level, and none of the time points reach statistical significance (no significance asterisks, in contrast to panel G/CBR). Therefore, no increase in tau acetylation was observed after hypothalamic TBI.

[ANSWER]D[/ANSWER]
